verified_facts.claim: Pat Becker is a TAR co-founder. TAR is headquartered in Austin, with manufacturing in West Texas.
On September 10th, 2026, TAR announced a $120 million Series A led by Spark Capital for office growth, West Texas manufacturing/logistics expansion and ongoing deployments.

TAR describes controlling site selection, design, procurement, construction, commissioning and operation, in place of coordinating those stages across third parties; Becker publicly explains this choice.
The company says TAR Terminal One is being finished in West Texas and an AI cloud deployment is underway.
The founders told Latitude they target builds in under six months; the first West Texas plant was expected to finish in September 2026.
Latitude reports a West Texas cloud project whose customer remains unnamed; no future project pipeline was supplied in response to its questions.
TAR plans excess solar and storage with emergency gas backup. The founders say the planned energy mix depends on location and sunlight. Existing competing off-grid projects use more gas.
Latitude identifies the land/capital cost of extra renewables and continuing equipment lead times. Founders contrast this with fuel and pipeline exposure.
